We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages
stories.t: Over the last week or so, we have seen a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought entire companies to a standstill, and a banking outage at JPMorgan Chase. But the consensus is that there are more to come.

stories.h: Watch live on Nov. 23: Amazon launching 1st batch of internet satellites since Vulcan Centaur failure
stories.t: An Ariane 6 rocket will launch 36 Amazon broadband satellites to orbit early on Nov. 23, just eight days after a ULA Vulcan Centaur failed during its mission for Amazon. Watch it live here.

stories.h: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
stories.t: Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people.

stories.h: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed
stories.t: Scientists have discovered a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel: at extreme speeds, the light propelling futuristic solar sails could actually begin slowing them down.
